subject: Sandbox gate plan — 4-week POC, multilanguage model routing & success rubric
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sana Rao <sana@shoply.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up + proposed 4-week sandbox + model routing suggestions

Hi Sana — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and a tight POC proposal so we can move to a sandbox without friction.

Recap of goals
- Replace first-tier returns/help chat with an LLM assistant that handles return eligibility, simple refunds, and 3 common policy exceptions.
- Multilingual coverage (English, Spanish, French) for chat UI + email templating.
- Latency and cost constraints to keep production economics viable for high-traffic windows.

POC proposal (4-week sandbox) — high level
- Week 0 (prep): dataset handoff & credentials, infra sandbox provisioned by Redwood (dedicated dev pool).
- Weeks 1–2 (eval): run parallel model A/B on a 10k prompt sample (live shadow + replay), collect quality/latency metrics.
- Week 3 (acceptance): run acceptance tests + small live pilot with 1% traffic.
- Week 4 (handoff): results review and rollout plan or small follow-on trial.

Success criteria (proposed pass/fail thresholds)
- Intent match / correctness: >= 85% on our labeled evaluation set (weighted by intent frequency).
- Resolution accuracy for returns cases: >= 80% automated accuracy (no human override).
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 400ms for English; <= 500ms for Spanish/French.
- Cost: steady-state inference cost <= target of $2.50 per 1k output tokens (we'll refine once we see sample distribution).

Model selection & routing (initial recommendation)
- Primary (English): Mistral-22B-instruct (best quality-latency balance on our internal benchmarks for transactional chat).
- Multilingual (Spanish/French): OpenAssistant-13B-v2 (strong multilingual responses and smaller memory footprint).
- Fallback: quantized Llama-2-13B-multilingual-q4 (used when p95 latency > target or GPU availability constrained).
- Routing policy: language-detect -> route to multilingual model for non-English; otherwise route to primary. If latency alert triggers for a model, dynamic fallback to quantized model for that route.

Evaluation plan highlights
- Shared prompt set (attached eval-promptset-v1.jsonl) with 10k curated prompts, 60:30:10 train/validation/edge split.
- Human-in-the-loop labeling for ambiguous intents (Neha to own).
- Metrics: exact-match, partial-match scoring, ROUGE-type paraphrase tolerance, and business-specific acceptance flags (refund_ok, escalate_to_human).

Ownership & next steps
- Connor (POC lead): coordinate sampling, HubSpot updates, and weekly check-ins.
- Neha (model eval): build scoring rubric, run batch evals, produce weekly quality report.
- Marcus (infra): provision sandbox, credentials, and route policies.

Attachments: poc-scoring-matrix.xlsx (scoring columns + thresholds), mutual-action-plan.docx (M.A.P with milestones).

Can you confirm: 1) the acceptance thresholds above look reasonable to Shoply, 2) are you able to share a small anonymized sample of historical chat transcripts (10–20k utterances) by EOD Friday so Neha can start building the rubric?

Thanks — Connor

--
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poc-scoring-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed 4-week sandbox + model routing suggestions

Thanks, Connor — this is very clear and aligns with our internal priorities. Two clarifications from our side before we hand over data: 

1) Success metrics: can we tighten intent match to >= 88% for purchase/returns intents (those are business-critical)? For other intents the 85% baseline is fine.
2) Data & compliance: our security team needs SOC 2 evidence and confirmation that PII will be redacted before it reaches the hosted sandbox. If necessary we can do an SFTP share for the sample.

I've looped in David (procurement) to keep timelines and contract gating on his radar. Tentatively we can target sandbox start the week of Sep 25 if the paperwork & sample can be ready.

Sana
Customer Experience Lead, Shoply

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: evaluation rubric & promptset adjustments (owner notes)

Connor / Marcus — quick internal note so we keep a single source of truth: 

Evaluation rubric (Neha owners)
- Gold labels: we need a 2-rater agreement on a random 2k sample for the acceptance set. If Cohen's kappa < 0.7 we expand labeling to 4k.
- Intent/slot scoring: weighted by business impact; returns=0.5 weight, refunds=0.2, misc=0.3.
- Edge cases: escalate_to_human flag must be correct >= 95% on pilot sample.

Model testing plan
- Shadow run for 48 hours on live traffic (read-only) + 10k replay tests from historical logs.
- Evaluate cost-per-conversation for each model combination; include KV cache warmup simulation for long sessions.

Data/PII handling
- We'll run a PII scrub pipeline on the sample (hashed user ids, strip payment tokens, mask emails). Marcus, can you scope the scrub CPU/throughput? I estimate 50k utterances per hour on our standard pipeline.

Deliverables & owners
- Eval results v1 (Neha) — due Sep 29.
- Infra sandbox + SFTP endpoint (Marcus) — due Sep 22.
- Signed MAP + sample (Connor & Shoply) — target Sep 22.

Neha

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Sana / Connor — infra update and ask from my side: 
- I can provision the dev pool (4 x A10G equivalent) by Sep 22 and expose an SFTP endpoint (sftp://sandbox.shoply.redwood.io). Retention: 14 days by default; we can shorten if Shoply requests.
- Sandbox will include dynamic routing rules (language detect + fallback) and a metrics exporter for p95 latency + cost per 1k tokens.

Action: Sana — please confirm you’re OK with the 14-day retention on sample data or tell us desired retention. Also confirm whether you want Private deployment (VPC) or hosted sandbox.

Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
